summary: new Date(existingDate) copies the source Date internal [[DateValue]] directly, without invoking overridden valueOf/toString hooks.

target.notes: Do not lower through generic ToPrimitive/ToNumber when the argument is proven to be a Date object with [[DateValue]].

tests.name: copies timestamp
tests.input: const a=new Date(1234); const b=new Date(a); console.log(b.getTime(),a===b);

tests.name: overridden valueOf is ignored
tests.input: const a=new Date(1234); a.valueOf=()=>999999; console.log(new Date(a).getTime());
